verdicts.reason: A turns the design into a left-to-right banner. The large 'Sunset Sessions' headline clearly leads, and the logo, headline and subtitle stack together on the left. Its flaws: the middle column is cramped, with the date jammed near the top edge and the legal text squeezed under the URL. The time line is indented slightly from the date, so they don't share an edge. The grey placeholder box sits isolated at the far right. B is worse. Its logo is tiny and stuck in the corner over the circle, and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' is left-aligned while the headline below it is centred. The 'TASTINGS' chip runs into the phone, and the legal line runs into the placeholder box at the bottom right, which also nearly touches the canvas edge. The headline is smaller, so the hierarchy is weaker.
